images.reasoning: Engine measured raw_score=0.114344 (aggregation: max over the sweep grid) from 54 evaluated grid cells over 29850 blocks of 8x8. The worst-conforming cell was frequency 4 at quality factor 74 with divergence 0.114344 and a zero-coefficient rate of 0.7623. Mean divergence across the grid was 0.068234, and the chi-square measured nearest the image's own quality factor was 0.991867 against Moin et al.'s published unaltered range of 0.0112-0.0126. Probability 0.1878 came from the calibration route recorded in the trace, at confidence 0.0900.
images.mathematical_explanation: The engine quantized every 8x8 DCT block with standard JPEG tables at quality factors 80/85/90/95/100, extracted the leading decimal digit of each surviving non-zero coefficient at zig-zag frequencies 1-9, and least-squares fitted the generalized Benford curve p(d)=beta*log_b(1+1/(gamma+d^delta)) to each histogram. The reported score is the largest unaveraged symmetric KL divergence between an observed histogram and its own fit. Because the curve is refitted per cell, the score measures how badly the digit histogram departs from ANY member of the generalized-Benford family, not from a fixed reference curve. For this image the fit at the worst cell converged to beta=2.3815, gamma=0.0, delta=2.9348, and 75.9% of quantized coefficients were exactly zero and therefore excluded, since a zero coefficient has no leading digit under d=floor(|c|/b^floor(log_b|c|)).

computation_steps.name: Condition check

computation_steps.name: Channel selection and blocking
computation_steps.description: Extracted the green channel, the only channel choice stated explicitly in the corpus (Moin & Islam 2017), then cropped to a whole block grid and partitioned into non-overlapping 8x8 blocks.

computation_steps.name: Block DCT
computation_steps.description: Applied the JPEG-normalized 2D DCT-II of Thai et al. 2012 Eq. 8 to every block, reproducing libjpeg-compatible coefficient magnitudes.

computation_steps.name: Digit-divergence sweep
computation_steps.description: For each cell of the sweep grid (bases [10], zig-zag frequencies [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9] (DC excluded), quality factors [80, 85, 90, 95, 100]), quantized the coefficients with the standard JPEG table, extracted leading digits, built the empirical pmf, least-squares fitted the generalized Benford curve p(d)=beta*log_b(1+1/(gamma+d^delta)), and measured the unaveraged symmetric KL divergence of Bonettini et al. 2021 Eq. 6. Zero-valued coefficients have no leading digit and were excluded as the SKILL file instructs.

The SKILL file states no calibration function exists in the corpus for this statistic, so this probability expresses relative ordering only and must not be read as a literal likelihood.
